authoring_request.subject: bahasa_inggris
authoring_request.student_goal: Siswa mampu menemukan gagasan utama, detail pendukung, dan inferensi sederhana dari teks pendek.

micro_concepts.concept_description: Membedakan ide utama dengan detail dan menarik simpulan sederhana dari petunjuk teks.

main_questions.subject: bahasa_inggris
main_questions.question: Read the text: "Rina loves reading. Every Sunday, she goes to the library with her brother. She borrows two story books and reads them at home." The main idea of the text is ...
options: Rina likes reading and regularly goes to the library
Rina borrows two books every day
Rina goes to the library alone
The library is closed on Sunday
main_questions.rationale: Ide utama merangkum keseluruhan teks: kebiasaan Rina membaca dan ke perpustakaan pada hari Minggu.

1.diagnosis: Kamu memilih detail spesifik yang sempit, bukan ringkasan isi teks.
1.micro_lesson: Main idea harus mencakup isi paling umum. Detail seperti jumlah buku hanya pendukung.

retry_question.question: Text: "Doni feeds his cat every morning. He also cleans the cage." The best main idea is ...
options: Doni feeds and takes care of his cat

2.diagnosis: Jawabanmu tidak didukung teks; ada informasi baru yang tidak disebutkan.
2.micro_lesson: Untuk reading, pilih jawaban yang punya bukti kalimat di teks, bukan asumsi.

retry_question.question: If the text says "Sita goes to school with her sister," which statement is supported by the text?
options: Sita takes the bus every day

3.diagnosis: Pilihan ini bertentangan langsung dengan informasi di teks.
3.micro_lesson: Cek ulang kata kunci seperti waktu dan kegiatan. Hindari opsi yang berlawanan isi teks.

retry_question.question: Text: "The class starts at 7 a.m." The correct statement is ...

main_questions.subject: bahasa_inggris
main_questions.question: Text: "Tomi has a blue bicycle. He rides it to school on Monday and Wednesday." Based on the text, on which days does Tomi go to school by bicycle?
main_questions.rationale: Detail waktu yang tertulis jelas adalah Monday dan Wednesday.

0.diagnosis: Kamu tertukar membaca detail hari yang disebutkan pada teks.
0.micro_lesson: Untuk soal detail, tandai kata waktu (day/date/time) lalu cocokkan persis ke opsi.

retry_question.question: Text: "Lina studies English on Tuesday." Lina studies English on ...

2.diagnosis: Pilihanmu mirip, tetapi hari kedua tidak sama dengan teks.
2.micro_lesson: Jangan menebak dari pola. Cocokkan kedua hari sekaligus sebelum memilih.

retry_question.question: Text: "Ani has piano class on Monday and Thursday." The correct answer is ...

3.diagnosis: Kamu menggeneralisasi informasi menjadi setiap hari, padahal teks hanya menyebut dua hari.
3.micro_lesson: Hindari kata absolut seperti "every day" jika teks tidak menyatakannya.

retry_question.question: If the text says "Budi plays football on Saturday", which is correct?

main_questions.subject: bahasa_inggris
main_questions.question: Text: "The sky is dark. The wind is strong. Rara takes her umbrella before leaving home." The most reasonable inference is ...
options: Today is very hot and sunny
main_questions.rationale: Langit gelap, angin kencang, dan membawa payung adalah petunjuk cuaca akan hujan.

0.diagnosis: Pilihan ini tidak didukung petunjuk pada teks.
0.micro_lesson: Inferensi harus lahir dari petunjuk teks. Cari kata kunci yang mengarah ke satu simpulan logis.

retry_question.question: Text: "Dino wears a jacket and scarf." The most likely conclusion is ...

2.diagnosis: Kamu memilih lokasi acak yang tidak terkait dengan petunjuk cuaca.
2.micro_lesson: Fokuskan inferensi pada hubungan sebab-akibat antar kalimat, bukan menambah konteks baru.

retry_question.question: Text: "Nina is yawning and her eyes are sleepy." The most accurate conclusion is ...

3.diagnosis: Pilihanmu bertolak belakang dengan petunjuk langit gelap dan payung.
3.micro_lesson: Saat inferensi, eliminasi dulu opsi yang berlawanan langsung dengan bukti teks.

retry_question.question: Text: "Clouds are thick and thunder is heard." What is the most likely weather condition?
options: There is no wind at all

drill_questions.subject: bahasa_inggris
drill_questions.question: The main idea of a paragraph is usually ...
options: The most general idea in the text
The most difficult word in the text
A title unrelated to the content
drill_questions.rationale: Main idea merangkum isi utama seluruh paragraf.

drill_questions.subject: bahasa_inggris
drill_questions.question: Text: "Mira drinks milk every morning." The correct detail is ...
drill_questions.rationale: Detail harus sama persis dengan informasi di teks.

drill_questions.subject: bahasa_inggris
drill_questions.question: Text: "Rudi is holding a map and asking for directions." The correct conclusion is ...
options: Rudi needs to find the way
drill_questions.rationale: Map dan bertanya arah menunjukkan ia mencari lokasi.

drill_questions.subject: bahasa_inggris
drill_questions.question: Text: "The school will hold a clean-up day on Friday. Students must bring gloves and trash bags." The main idea of the text is ...
options: An announcement about school clean-up day
Students are not allowed to come to school
drill_questions.rationale: Teks berisi informasi utama tentang kegiatan clean-up day.

drill_questions.subject: bahasa_inggris
drill_questions.question: Text: "Nina checks her watch many times. The bus has not arrived yet." The most likely conclusion is ...
options: Nina is waiting for the bus
drill_questions.rationale: Petunjuk menandakan ia menunggu bus yang belum datang.

drill_focus.notes: Eliminasi opsi yang bertentangan dengan petunjuk.
